description: This file defines a Java interface 'DefinitionIdentifier' that represents a fully qualified identifier for definitions such as 'Thing' and 'Feature' within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides method signatures to retrieve namespace, name, version, and string representation of the identifier.

classes.name: DefinitionIdentifier
classes.description: An interface representing a fully qualified identifier for definitions such as Thing and Feature, including methods to access namespace, name, version, and string format.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace component of the identifier.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name component of the identifier.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version component of the identifier.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the identifier in the format 'namespace:name:version'.
